body.x: 1MORE unveiled its remarkable various sound equipments at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

1MORE E1008 is one of the flagship products which is not only high-level design and also recognized its efficiency as a Dual Driver structure. It offers a comfortable fit for the user using a variety of earpieces. The earpieces do not drop from the ear because of its fitting stability and also reduce the pain in the worn conditions for a long time.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
